channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: North Macedonia reports fifth West Nile virus death
item.description: A fifth fatality linked to West Nile virus was confirmed on Saturday in North Macedonia, where authorities are carrying out widespread mosquito control.

item.title: Officials caution wildland firefighters on supplement for smoke exposure
item.description: Fire and medical officials have cautioned against a supplement marketed to Western wildland firefighters exposed to toxic chemicals, citing potential risks.

item.title: Cottage cheese health claims fail evidence check
item.description: Cottage cheese is trending in recipes, but an evidence review finds its touted health benefits may be overstated.

item.title: Prostate cancer diagnosed every eight minutes in UK
item.description: A charity reports over 68,000 UK men are diagnosed with prostate cancer annually, and warns that myths may deter men from seeking checks.
